ratings_why.fun: Every shop becomes a menu of texts and the growth ramps cleanly from Grub and Nursemaid to Bee Orchid, Moll and Bettie, though the early turns lean on whatever weak Tier 1 texts the shop rolls.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because wearing a shop unit and leaving a 1-gold Stock changes how you read every shop and every refresh; no tribe today turns other tribes' cards into your build.

verdict_why: The Stock's own wear is unclear, and Alder Whittler's value hangs on it; the rest would only get different.

points.text: Stock says it 'can wear' the unit it replaced: can a bought Stock do that on its own, or only under Alder Whittler or Wicker Moll? If on its own, the Whittler does nothing.
If Stocks can't wear by themselves, the Whittler is fine; if they can, give the Whittler's Stocks +1/+1 so it is a small Moll.
Turns 1-3 rely on the shop's Tier 1 texts; a Tier 1 that rewards its first wear with gold or a bigger body would steady the opening.
With the tier-minus-2 rule, Porter of the Seven Doors matters mostly mid-game; letting it also raise Stocks' caps would keep it live under Moll.
Bettie Underhill multiplies guises by Changelings, so the Moll and Tod builds both land on her; a clean late payoff with a clear shape.

standouts.why: Wicker Moll turns every guise into two copies of a text and fills the board for the payoffs.
Hoverfly Guest makes reading the opponent's last board a real draft choice.
Inside-Out Tod turns selling an outgrown golden into a wear and a stat gain.

weakest.why: Pip Unlike's mirror only matters for left-right text, so it is usually a plain Guise body.
Porter of the Seven Doors is a low-stat tier raiser the tier-minus-2 rule partly covers.
Coat-Peg Steward is under the in-fight target and needs Changelings to die first.

flags.note: Every Stock is a 3/6 with up to Tier 5 text for 1 gold; bounded by board space and Guise actions, but very hot.
With Tod selling Moll's Stocks, each gold can add two Bettie stacks across seven Changelings; gold-bounded, high roll.
Golden Lady with Grandfer Acorn wearing Glamour-Weavers stacks many free When-played triggers; linear but a very high ceiling.
Penny Second's text wipe hard-counters front-row carries; the counter is moving text units to the back row.
Whether a Stock can wear its remembered unit without the Whittler or Moll.
